instruction: events.csv contains id,user,day,event,second,region. First discard rows outside west, then process in ascending id. Session state is separate for each (user,day). A start replaces any pending start. A stop consumes a pending start and contributes stop.second minus start.second only if that duration is at most 1200; without a pending start it contributes zero. Remaining starts contribute zero. Return total contributed seconds as an integer. Use Python through bash. Work only inside the current directory.
